mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{beginDate}::date AND create_time < #{endDate}::date + interval '1 day'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0' AND close_time IS NOT NULL AND close_time >= #{beginDate}::date AND close_time < #{endDate}::date + interval '1 day'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = 'ongoing'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'refund' THEN -COALESCE(amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(amount, 0) END), 0) AS "amount" FROM proj_payment WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_time >= #{beginDate}::date AND pay_time < #{endDate}::date + interval '1 day'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'refund' THEN -COALESCE(amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(amount, 0) END), 0) AS "amount" FROM proj_payment WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_time >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.external_output), 0) AS "amount" FROM proj_workload w JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = w.project_id AND p.del_flag = '0' WHERE w.del_flag = '0' AND p.close_time IS NOT NULL AND p.close_time >= #{beginDate}::date AND p.close_time < #{endDate}::date + interval '1 day'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.external_output), 0) AS "amount" FROM proj_workload w JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = w.project_id AND p.del_flag = '0' WHERE w.del_flag = '0' AND p.close_time IS NOT NULL AND p.close_time >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(contract_amount), 0) AS "totalAmount", COALESCE(SUM(received_amount), 0) AS "receivedAmount" FROM proj_contract WHERE del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_contract WHERE del_flag = '0'

SELECT t.id, t.task_name AS "taskName", p.project_name AS "projectName", t.required_finish_date AS "requiredFinishDate", t.status, (CURRENT_DATE - t.required_finish_date::date) AS "overdueDays" FROM proj_task t JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = t.project_id WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND p.del_flag = '0' AND t.actual_finish_date IS NULL AND t.required_finish_date IS NOT NULL AND t.required_finish_date < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY t.required_finish_date ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_task t JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = t.project_id WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND p.del_flag = '0' AND t.actual_finish_date IS NULL AND t.required_finish_date IS NOT NULL AND t.required_finish_date < CURRENT_DATE

SELECT (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proj_material_flow f WHERE f.material_id = m.id AND f.flow_type = '领取' AND f.del_flag = '0' AND COALESCE(f.pickup_type, 'paper') IN ('electronic', 'both')) THEN (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proj_material_flow f2 WHERE f2.material_id = m.id AND f2.flow_type = '领取' AND f2.del_flag = '0' AND COALESCE(f2.pickup_type, 'paper') IN ('paper', 'both')) THEN 'received_both' ELSE 'received_electronic' END) WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proj_material_flow f3 WHERE f3.material_id = m.id AND f3.flow_type = '领取' AND f3.del_flag = '0') THEN 'received_paper' ELSE 'pending' END) AS "name", COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM proj_material m WHERE m.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY 1

SELECT to_char(m, 'YYYY-MM') AS "label", COALESCE(SUM(w.total_output), 0) AS "output", COALESCE(SUM(p.total_payment), 0) AS "payment" FROM generate_series( date_trunc('month', #{beginDate}::date), date_trunc('month', #{endDate}::date), '1 month'::interval ) m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('month', pj.close_time) AS mo, SUM(COALESCE(wk.external_output, 0)) AS total_output FROM proj_workload wk JOIN proj_project pj ON pj.id = wk.project_id AND pj.del_flag = '0' WHERE wk.del_flag = '0' AND pj.close_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY date_trunc('month', pj.close_time) ) w ON w.mo = m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('month', pay_time) AS mo, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'refund' THEN -COALESCE(amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(amount, 0) END) AS total_payment FROM proj_payment WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', pay_time) ) p ON p.mo = m GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

SELECT COALESCE(c.name, '未分类') AS "name", COALESCE(SUM(w.external_output), 0) AS "value" FROM proj_workload w JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = w.project_id AND p.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN proj_category c ON c.id = w.category_id AND c.del_flag = '0' WHERE w.del_flag = '0' AND p.close_time IS NOT NULL AND p.close_time >= #{beginDate}::date AND p.close_time < #{endDate}::date + interval '1 day' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY "value" DESC

SELECT label, SUM(monthly) OVER (ORDER BY label ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "cumulative" FROM ( SELECT to_char(m, 'YYYY-MM') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(w.total_output), 0) AS monthly FROM generate_series( date_trunc('year', #{beginDate}::date), date_trunc('month', #{endDate}::date), '1 month'::interval ) m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('month', pj.close_time) AS mo, SUM(COALESCE(wk.external_output, 0)) AS total_output FROM proj_workload wk JOIN proj_project pj ON pj.id = wk.project_id AND pj.del_flag = '0' WHERE wk.del_flag = '0' AND pj.close_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY date_trunc('month', pj.close_time) ) w ON w.mo = m GROUP BY m ) t ORDER BY label

SELECT to_char(m, 'YYYY-MM') AS "label", COALESCE(np.cnt, 0) AS "newProjects", COALESCE(cp.cnt, 0) AS "completedProjects" FROM generate_series( date_trunc('month', #{beginDate}::date), date_trunc('month', #{endDate}::date), '1 month'::interval ) m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('month', create_time) AS mo, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', create_time) ) np ON np.mo = m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('month', close_time) AS mo, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM proj_project WHERE del_flag = '0' AND close_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY date_trunc('month', close_time) ) cp ON cp.mo = m ORDER BY m

SELECT contract_no AS "contractNo", contract_name AS "contractName", COALESCE(contract_amount, 0) AS "contractAmount", COALESCE(received_amount, 0) AS "receivedAmount", CASE WHEN COALESCE(contract_amount, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(received_amount / contract_amount * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS "progress" FROM proj_contract WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY contract_amount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.id AS "projectId", p.project_code AS "projectCode", p.project_name AS "projectName", COALESCE(c.name, '未分类') AS "categoryName", COALESCE(p.client_unit, '') AS "clientUnit", COALESCE(SUM(w.external_output), 0) AS "output" FROM proj_workload w JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = w.project_id AND p.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN proj_category c ON c.id = w.category_id AND c.del_flag = '0' WHERE w.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY p.id, p.project_code, p.project_name, c.name, p.client_unit HAVING COALESCE(SUM(w.external_output), 0) > 0 ORDER BY "output" DESC LIMIT 10

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proj_leader pl WHERE pl.project_id = p.id AND pl.user_id = #{q.leaderId} AND pl.del_flag = '0')

mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pl.project_id, string_agg(u.nick_name, ',') AS names FROM proj_leader pl JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = pl.user_id WHERE pl.del_flag = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY pl.project_id ) ln ON ln.project_id = p.id
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.sign_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) AND c.sign_date < date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) + interval '1 year' THEN COALESCE(c.contract_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "annual", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.sign_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 year' AND c.sign_date < date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) THEN COALESCE(c.contract_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "annualPrev", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.sign_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND c.sign_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + interval '1 month' THEN COALESCE(c.contract_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "month", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.sign_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month' AND c.sign_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN COALESCE(c.contract_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "monthPrev" FROM proj_contract c WHERE c.del_flag = '0'

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.assign_date IS NOT NULL AND p.assign_date >= #{q.beginDate}::date AND p.assign_date < #{q.endDate}::date + interval '1 day') AS "periodNew", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.assign_date IS NOT NULL AND p.assign_date >= #{q.compareBeginDate}::date AND p.assign_date < #{q.compareEndDate}::date + interval '1 day') AS "periodNewPrev", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.close_time IS NOT NULL AND p.close_time >= #{q.beginDate}::date AND p.close_time < #{q.endDate}::date + interval '1 day') AS "periodCompleted", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.close_time IS NOT NULL AND p.close_time >= #{q.compareBeginDate}::date AND p.close_time < #{q.compareEndDate}::date + interval '1 day') AS "periodCompletedPrev" FROM proj_project p WHERE p.del_flag = '0'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay.pay_time >= #{q.beginDate}::date AND pay.pay_time < #{q.endDate}::date + interval '1 day' THEN CASE WHEN pay.payment_type = 'refund' THEN -COALESCE(pay.amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(pay.amount, 0) END ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "periodPayment", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay.pay_time >= #{q.compareBeginDate}::date AND pay.pay_time < #{q.compareEndDate}::date + interval '1 day' THEN CASE WHEN pay.payment_type = 'refund' THEN -COALESCE(pay.amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(pay.amount, 0) END ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "periodPaymentPrev" FROM proj_payment pay JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = pay.project_id AND p.del_flag = '0' WHERE pay.del_flag = '0' AND pay.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(p.project_nature, 'normal') <> 'mandate'

SELECT p.id, p.project_code AS "projectCode", p.project_name AS "projectName", COALESCE(p.client_unit, '') AS "clientUnit", p.assign_date AS "assignDate", p.close_time AS "closeTime", p.status, p.duration_require AS "durationRequire", COALESCE(ln.names, '') AS "leaderNames" FROM proj_project p
WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.data_source = 'manual' AND p.assign_date IS NOT NULL AND p.duration_require IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total", COUNT(p.duration_require) AS "maintained" FROM proj_project p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.data_source = 'manual'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "all", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'ongoing') AS "active" FROM proj_project p WHERE p.del_flag = '0'
SELECT id, name FROM proj_category WHERE del_flag = '0'

SELECT p.project_category_id AS "categoryId", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.assign_date >= #{q.beginDate}::date AND p.assign_date < #{q.endDate}::date + interval '1 day') AS "count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.close_time >= #{q.beginDate}::date AND p.close_time < #{q.endDate}::date + interval '1 day') AS "closedCount", COALESCE(SUM(ws.int_out) FILTER (WHERE p.close_time >= #{q.beginDate}::date AND p.close_time < #{q.endDate}::date + interval '1 day'), 0) AS "internalOutput", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.project_nature, 'normal') = 'mandate' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(ws.ext_out, 0) END) FILTER (WHERE p.close_time >= #{q.beginDate}::date AND p.close_time < #{q.endDate}::date + interval '1 day'), 0) AS "externalOutput", COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(ct.contract_amount, 0)) FILTER (WHERE p.assign_date >= #{q.beginDate}::date AND p.assign_date < #{q.endDate}::date + interval '1 day'), 0) AS "contractAmount" FROM proj_project p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(COALESCE(internal_output, 0)) AS int_out, SUM(COALESCE(external_output, 0)) AS ext_out FROM proj_workload WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY project_id ) ws ON ws.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN proj_contract ct ON ct.id = p.contract_id AND ct.del_flag = '0' WHERE p.del_flag = '0'
GROUP BY p.project_category_id

SELECT pl.user_id AS "leaderId", p.project_category_id AS "categoryId", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.assign_date >= #{q.beginDate}::date AND p.assign_date < #{q.endDate}::date + interval '1 day') AS "count", COALESCE(SUM(ws.int_out) FILTER (WHERE p.close_time >= #{q.beginDate}::date AND p.close_time < #{q.endDate}::date + interval '1 day'), 0) AS "internalOutput", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.project_nature, 'normal') = 'mandate' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(ws.ext_out, 0) END) FILTER (WHERE p.close_time >= #{q.beginDate}::date AND p.close_time < #{q.endDate}::date + interval '1 day'), 0) AS "externalOutput" FROM proj_leader pl JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = pl.project_id AND p.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(COALESCE(internal_output, 0)) AS int_out, SUM(COALESCE(external_output, 0)) AS ext_out FROM proj_workload WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY project_id ) ws ON ws.project_id = p.id WHERE pl.del_flag = '0'
GROUP BY pl.user_id, p.project_category_id
SELECT DISTINCT pl.user_id AS "userId", u.nick_name AS "nickName" FROM proj_leader pl JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = pl.user_id WHERE pl.del_flag = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_workload w JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = w.project_id AND p.del_flag = '0' WHERE w.del_flag = '0' AND w.external_output IS NULL AND p.close_time IS NOT NULL AND p.close_time >= #{q.beginDate}::date AND p.close_time < #{q.endDate}::date + interval '1 day'

SELECT label, monthly, SUM(monthly) OVER (ORDER BY label ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "cumulative" FROM ( SELECT to_char(m, 'YYYY-MM') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(w.total_output), 0) AS monthly FROM generate_series( date_trunc('year', #{q.beginDate}::date), date_trunc('month', #{q.endDate}::date), '1 month'::interval ) m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('month', p.close_time) AS mo, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.project_nature, 'normal') = 'mandate' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(wk.external_output, 0) END) AS total_output FROM proj_workload wk JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = wk.project_id AND p.del_flag = '0' WHERE wk.del_flag = '0' AND p.close_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', p.close_time) ) w ON w.mo = m GROUP BY m ) t ORDER BY label

SELECT to_char(m, 'YYYY-MM') AS "label", COALESCE(np.cnt, 0) AS "newProjects", COALESCE(cp.cnt, 0) AS "completedProjects", COALESCE(pay.amt, 0) AS "paymentAmount" FROM generate_series( date_trunc('month', #{q.beginDate}::date), date_trunc('month', #{q.endDate}::date), '1 month'::interval ) m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('month', p.assign_date) AS mo, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM proj_project p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.assign_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', p.assign_date) ) np ON np.mo = m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('month', p.close_time) AS mo, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM proj_project p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.close_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', p.close_time) ) cp ON cp.mo = m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT date_trunc('month', pay.pay_time) AS mo, SUM(CASE WHEN pay.payment_type = 'refund' THEN -COALESCE(pay.amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(pay.amount, 0) END) AS amt FROM proj_payment pay JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = pay.project_id AND p.del_flag = '0' WHERE pay.del_flag = '0' AND pay.pay_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', pay.pay_time) ) pay ON pay.mo = m ORDER BY m

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('year', p.close_time), 'YYYY') AS "year", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.project_nature, 'normal') = 'mandate' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(ws.ext_out, 0) END), 0) AS "outputBase", COALESCE(SUM(ps.recv), 0) AS "received", COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.project_nature, 'normal') = 'mandate' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(ws.ext_out, 0) END - COALESCE(ps.recv, 0), 0)), 0) AS "debt" FROM proj_project p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(COALESCE(external_output, 0)) AS ext_out FROM proj_workload WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY project_id ) ws ON ws.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'refund' THEN -COALESCE(amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(amount, 0) END) AS recv FROM proj_payment WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id ) ps ON ps.project_id = p.id WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.close_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY date_trunc('year', p.close_time) ORDER BY date_trunc('year', p.close_time)

SELECT p.id AS "projectId", p.project_code AS "projectCode", p.project_name AS "projectName", COALESCE(p.client_unit, '') AS "clientUnit", p.close_time AS "closeTime", GREATEST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.project_nature, 'normal') = 'mandate' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(ws.ext_out, 0) END - COALESCE(ps.recv, 0), 0) AS "amount", COALESCE(ln.names, '') AS "leaderNames" FROM proj_project p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(COALESCE(external_output, 0)) AS ext_out FROM proj_workload WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY project_id ) ws ON ws.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'refund' THEN -COALESCE(amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(amount, 0) END) AS recv FROM proj_payment WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id ) ps ON ps.project_id = p.id
WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.close_time IS NOT NULL AND GREATEST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.project_nature, 'normal') = 'mandate' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(ws.ext_out, 0) END - COALESCE(ps.recv, 0), 0) > 0
ORDER BY p.close_time ASC

SELECT p.id AS "projectId", p.project_code AS "projectCode", p.project_name AS "projectName", COALESCE(p.client_unit, '') AS "clientUnit", p.create_time AS "createTime", COALESCE(ln.names, '') AS "leaderNames" FROM proj_project p
WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.data_source = 'manual' AND p.contract_id IS NULL AND p.create_time IS NOT NULL AND p.create_time < CURRENT_DATE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ws.ext_out), 0) AS "mandateExternalOutput", COUNT(*) AS "mandateProjectCount" FROM proj_project p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(COALESCE(external_output, 0)) AS ext_out FROM proj_workload WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY project_id ) ws ON ws.project_id = p.id WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.close_time IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(p.project_nature, 'normal') = 'mandate' AND p.close_time >= #{q.beginDate}::date AND p.close_time < #{q.endDate}::date + interval '1 day'
